subject.title: [F3] fix(trajectory): record session.ended after cleanup, derive status from cleanup failures

question: Which same-root trajectory fix should be the landing path for the timestamp bug: this minimal no-new-event PR, the sibling PR that adds `session.cleanup_completed`, or a maintainer replacement?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same source-reproducible bug but encode different trace-event contracts, and automation should not choose the permanent event surface for maintainers.

options.title: Land the minimal event-surface fix
options.body: Merge this PR if maintainers want to move `session.ended` to the cleanup boundary without adding a new exported runtime event.

options.title: Prefer the cleanup-event sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102058 if maintainers want an explicit cleanup-completed event and accept the docs/event-surface follow-up.

options.title: Open a maintainer replacement
options.body: Close contributor variants only after a maintainer-owned patch captures the chosen behavior and proof.

recommendation.title: Land the minimal event-surface fix
recommendation.body: Merge this PR if maintainers want to move `session.ended` to the cleanup boundary without adding a new exported runtime event.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available routing signal from blame on the current trajectory block plus documented Agents/Telemetry ownership in CONTRIBUTING.md.
